entities.summary: The Airport Line  is a railway line in Aichi Prefecture, Japan, operated by the private railway operator Meitetsu, connecting Tokoname Station and Central Japan International Airport Station in Tokoname. The line opened, dual track and electrified, on 29 January 2005, and features a 1,076 m (3,530 ft) bridge over Ise Bay to the artificial island where the airport is situated. The line is operated as an extension of the Meitetsu Tokoname Line.
